text: Yes, the forest on the property was partially cleared in 2023. About 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the total area) of tree cover was lost, according to satellite data from Hansen/UMD. This loss was corroborated by reference maps showing that the area was forested in 2020. However, the type of forest in the affected area was not native—it was likely a Eucalyptus plantation (0.4 ha) or other non-native forest (0.3 ha). The change could have been due to harvesting, clearing, or another cause, but the exact reason isn’t clear from the data. The evidence doesn’t confirm whether the clearing was legal or who was responsible.
